args: Do the zero-activity 'Warehouse' sites hold real inventory?

The apparel merchants' secondary sites named '...Warehouse' (as opposed to '...Fulfilment Centre') showed zero stock-count activity all year — are these empty/inactive shells, or do they hold meaningful live inventory that is simply never being counted (a blind spot)?

For pct_of_tenant_total_stock_units, compute each tenant's grand total stock_items.quantity across ALL of its warehouses (not just the named one) as the denominator. Order by total_stock_on_hand descending, tie-break by warehouse_name.", "builds_on": ["Apparel/footwear discrepancies by warehouse: scale effect or genuine elevated rate?"]}
